description.en: Master human attention, emotional content psychology and viral communication systems to become a dangerous content creator.

core_concept.en: Attention is the currency of the internet.

summary.en: Every second, people decide if your content deserves attention. Humans scroll extremely fast because the brain filters boring information automatically.
summary.fr: Chaque seconde, les gens décident si votre contenu mérite leur attention. Les humains font défiler très vite car le cerveau filtre automatiquement les informations ennuyeuses.
